ru.R: Я приду и расскажу о великих делах, которые совершил Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. \q Я буду напоминать всем, как {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} добр и справедлив — {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}}, и никто другой.

ja.L: わたしは、{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}の力あるみわざと共に行こう。 \q あなたの義を、ただあなたのものだけを、わたしは告げ知らせよう。
ja.B: わたしは行って、{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}の力あるみわざを語ろう。 \q あなたの義を、ほかのだれのものでもない、あなたの義を、わたしは思い起こさせよう。
ja.R: わたしは行って、{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}がなさった偉大なことを話そう。 \q ほかのだれでもない、あなたがどんなに良く、正しい方かを、みなに思い出させよう。

decisions.choice: I will come with the mighty deeds: come to tell of them
alternatives: I will come in the strength of the Lord GOD
decisions.reason: He may mean he will come before God, perhaps to the temple, with the story of God's mighty acts to tell; or that he will go on in the strength those acts give.

decisions.choice: the Lord YHWH
decisions.reason: As in verse 5, the title followed by the divine name.

decisions.choice: make mention: proclaim, call to mind
decisions.reason: The verb (zakar in the causative) means to bring to remembrance, to speak of so that others remember (20:8; 45:18).

decisions.choice: "of the Lord GOD" with the possessive on both words: "የጌታን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}}"
decisions.reason: As the terms list settles for "the LORD your God", a prefix or suffix goes on both words of the title, and the whole inflected name goes in each option of the span.

decisions.choice: 'avo' bigvurot "力あるみわざと共に行こう" (L), "行って…みわざを語ろう" (B), "行って…偉大なことを話そう" (R); 'azkir "告げ知らせよう" (L), "思い起こさせよう" (B), "思い出させよう" (R)
decisions.reason: "Come with the mighty deeds" is read as coming to tell of them (m1, uncertain); hizkir is proclaiming, calling to mind (m3).

source.text: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים לִמַּדְתַּ֥נִי מִנְּעוּרָ֑י וְעַד־הֵ֝֗נָּה אַגִּ֥יד נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: God, you have taught me from my youth, and until now I declare your wonders.

en.L: God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have taught me from my youth, \q and until now I declare {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wonders.
en.B: God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have been teaching me since I was young, \q and I am telling of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wonders still.
en.R: God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have taught me ever since I was young. \q And I still tell people about the amazing things {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do.

fr.L: Ô Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as instruit depuis ma jeunesse, \q et jusqu’à présent je proclame {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} merveilles.
fr.B: Ô Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’instruis depuis ma jeunesse, \q et je raconte encore {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} merveilles.
fr.R: Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as appris depuis que je suis jeune. \q Et je raconte encore aux gens les choses étonnantes que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais.

sw.L: Ee Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umenifundisha tangu ujana wangu, \q na mpaka sasa nayatangaza maajabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Ee Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umekuwa ukinifundisha tangu nilipokuwa kijana, \q nami bado ninasimulia maajabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umenifundisha tangu nilipokuwa kijana. \q Nami bado nawaambia watu mambo ya ajabu unayoyatenda.

es.L: Oh Dios, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me has enseñado desde mi juventud, \q y hasta ahora anuncio {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} maravillas.
es.B: Oh Dios, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me has venido enseñando desde que era joven, \q y todavía hoy hablo de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} maravillas.
es.R: Dios, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me has enseñado desde que era joven. \q Y todavía cuento a la gente las cosas asombrosas que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} haces.

vi.L: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dạy dỗ tôi từ thuở tôi còn trẻ, \q và cho đến nay tôi vẫn rao truyền những việc kỳ diệu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dạy dỗ tôi từ khi tôi còn trẻ, \q và đến nay tôi vẫn còn kể lại những việc kỳ diệu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dạy dỗ tôi từ khi tôi còn trẻ. \q Và tôi vẫn kể cho người ta nghe những việc tuyệt diệu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm.

ko.L: 하나님, 주님께서 제가 어릴 때부터 저를 가르치셨고, \q 지금까지 제가 주님의 기이한 일들을 전합니다.
ko.B: 하나님, 주님께서는 어릴 때부터 저를 가르쳐 오셨고, \q 저는 지금도 주님의 놀라운 일들을 전하고 있습니다.
ko.R: 하나님, 주님께서는 제가 어릴 때부터 저를 가르쳐 주셨습니다. \q 저는 지금도 주님께서 하시는 놀라운 일들을 사람들에게 이야기합니다.

pt.L: Deus, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me ensinaste desde a minha juventude, \q e até agora anuncio as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} maravilhas.
pt.B: Deus, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me ensinas desde que eu era jovem, \q e ainda hoje falo das {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} maravilhas.
pt.R: Deus, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me ensinaste desde que eu era jovem. \q E ainda conto às pessoas as coisas maravilhosas que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fazes.

am.L: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ከወጣትነቴ ጀምሮ አስተማርኸኝ፤ \q እስከ አሁንም ድንቅ ሥራዎችህን እናገራለሁ።
am.B: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ከወጣትነቴ ጀምሮ ስታስተምረኝ ኖረሃል፤ \q እኔም እስከ ዛሬ ድንቅ ሥራዎችህን እያወራሁ ነው።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ከልጅነቴ ጀምሮ አስተማርኸኝ። \q አሁንም ስለምታደርጋቸው አስደናቂ ነገሮች ለሰዎች እናገራለሁ።

hi.L: हे परमेश्वर, तूने मुझे मेरी जवानी से सिखाया है, \q और अब तक मैं तेरे आश्चर्यकर्मों का वर्णन करता हूँ।
hi.B: हे परमेश्वर, तू मुझे जवानी से सिखाता आया है, \q और मैं आज भी तेरे आश्चर्यकर्मों के बारे में बता रहा हूँ।
hi.R: हे परमेश्वर, जब से मैं जवान था, तब से तूने मुझे सिखाया है। \q और मैं अब भी लोगों को तेरे अद्भुत कामों के बारे में बताता हूँ।

ru.L: Боже, {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} учил меня от юности моей, \q и доныне я возвещаю чудеса {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}}.
ru.B: Боже, {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} учишь меня с юных лет, \q и я до сих пор рассказываю о {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} чудесах.
ru.R: Боже, {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} учил меня с тех пор, как я был молодым. \q И я до сих пор рассказываю людям об удивительных делах, которые {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} совершаешь.

ja.L: 神よ、あなたはわたしの若い時から、わたしを教えてこられた。 \q 今に至るまで、わたしはあなたの奇しいみわざを告げ知らせている。
ja.B: 神よ、あなたは若い時から、わたしを教えてくださった。 \q わたしは今もなお、あなたの不思議なみわざを語り伝えている。
ja.R: 神よ、あなたは、わたしが若いころから教えてくださった。 \q わたしは今も、あなたがなさる驚くべきことを人々に話している。

decisions.choice: your wonders: God's amazing acts
decisions.reason: The word (nifla'ot) is used of God's great acts of rescue, such as the exodus (9:2; 40:6).

decisions.choice: nifle'otekha "奇しいみわざ" (L), "不思議なみわざ" (B), "驚くべきこと" (R)
decisions.reason: The Psalter's word for God's wonders (PSA-3, 26:7).

source.text: וְגַ֤ם עַד־זִקְנָ֨ה׀וְשֵׂיבָה֮ אֱלֹהִ֪ים אַֽל־תַּעַ֫זְבֵ֥נִי עַד־אַגִּ֣יד זְרוֹעֲךָ֣ לְד֑וֹר לְכָל־יָ֝ב֗וֹא גְּבוּרָתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And even to old age and gray hair, God, do not forsake me, until I declare your arm to a generation, to all who will come your might.

en.L: And even to old age and gray hair, God, do not forsake me, \q until I declare {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} arm to [the next] generation, \q {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} might to all who are to come.
en.B: Now that I am old and gray, God, do not abandon me, \q not until I have told the generation after me what {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} arm has done, \q and made {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} power known to all who are yet to be born.
en.R: Now I am old and my hair is gray. God, do not leave me. \q Let me first tell the young people how strong {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are. \q Let me tell everyone who comes after me about {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} power.

fr.L: Et même jusqu’à la vieillesse et aux cheveux blancs, ô Dieu, ne m’abandonne pas, \q jusqu’à ce que je proclame {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} bras à [la] génération [qui vient], \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} puissance à tous ceux qui viendront.
fr.B: Maintenant que je suis vieux et que mes cheveux sont blancs, ô Dieu, ne m’abandonne pas, \q pas avant que j’aie raconté à la génération d’après ce qu’a fait {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} bras, \q et fait connaître {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} puissance à tous ceux qui sont encore à naître.
fr.R: Maintenant, je suis vieux et j’ai les cheveux blancs. Dieu, ne me laisse pas. \q Laisse-moi d’abord dire aux jeunes combien {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es fort. \q Laisse-moi parler de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} puissance à tous ceux qui viendront après moi.

sw.L: Na hata mpaka uzee na mvi, Ee Mungu, usiniache, \q hata niutangaze mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kwa kizazi [kijacho], \q uweza {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kwa wote watakaokuja.
sw.B: Sasa kwa kuwa nimezeeka na kuwa na mvi, Ee Mungu, usiniache, \q mpaka nimekiambia kizazi kinachonifuata yale mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} uliyoyatenda, \q na kuwajulisha uweza {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wote ambao bado hawajazaliwa.
sw.R: Sasa mimi ni mzee na nywele zangu zimekuwa mvi. Mungu, usiniache. \q Niache kwanza niwaambie vijana jinsi {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulivyo na nguvu. \q Niache niwaambie wote watakaokuja baada yangu habari za uweza {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.

es.L: Y aun hasta la vejez y las canas, oh Dios, no me abandones, \q hasta que anuncie {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} brazo a [la] generación [siguiente], \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} poder a todos los que han de venir.
es.B: Ahora que soy viejo y canoso, oh Dios, no me abandones, \q no hasta que haya contado a la generación que viene después de mí lo que ha hecho {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} brazo, \q y haya dado a conocer {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} poder a todos los que aún han de nacer.
es.R: Ahora soy viejo y tengo canas. Dios, no me dejes. \q Déjame primero decirles a los jóvenes lo fuerte que eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}. \q Déjame contar a todos los que vienen después de mí lo grande que es {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} poder.

vi.L: Và ngay cả đến lúc già nua tóc bạc, lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin đừng lìa bỏ tôi, \q cho đến khi tôi rao truyền cánh tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho thế hệ [sau], \q [và] quyền năng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho tất cả những người sẽ đến.
vi.B: Giờ đây khi tôi đã già và tóc đã bạc, lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin đừng bỏ rơi tôi, \q cho đến khi tôi kể cho thế hệ sau tôi biết những việc cánh tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm, \q và cho mọi người chưa sinh ra biết quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Bây giờ tôi đã già và tóc đã bạc. Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin đừng bỏ tôi. \q Xin cho tôi được kể trước cho lớp người trẻ biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mạnh mẽ dường nào. \q Xin cho tôi kể cho mọi người đến sau tôi về quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 늙어 백발이 될 때까지도, 하나님, 저를 버리지 마십시오. \q 제가 주님의 팔을 [다음] 세대에게 전하고, \q 주님의 능력을 앞으로 올 모든 이에게 [전할] 때까지.
ko.B: 이제 제가 늙어 머리가 희었으니, 하나님, 저를 버리지 마십시오. \q 주님의 팔이 하신 일을 제 뒤에 올 세대에게 전하고, \q 앞으로 태어날 모든 사람에게 주님의 힘을 알릴 때까지 버리지 마십시오.
ko.R: 이제 저는 늙어서 머리가 하얗게 세었습니다. 하나님, 저를 떠나지 마십시오. \q 주님께서 얼마나 강하신지 먼저 젊은이들에게 이야기하게 해 주십시오. \q 제 뒤에 올 모든 사람에게 주님의 능력을 이야기하게 해 주십시오.

pt.L: E até a velhice e os cabelos brancos, Deus, não me abandones, \q até que eu anuncie o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} braço [à próxima] geração, \q o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} poder a todos os que hão de vir.
pt.B: Agora que estou velho e de cabelos brancos, Deus, não me abandones, \q não antes que eu conte à geração depois de mim o que o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} braço fez \q e torne o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} poder conhecido a todos os que ainda vão nascer.
pt.R: Agora estou velho, e o meu cabelo está branco. Deus, não me deixes. \q Deixa-me primeiro contar aos jovens como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és forte. \q Deixa-me contar a todos os que vierem depois de mim sobre o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} poder.

am.L: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ እስከ እርጅናና እስከ ሽበትም ድረስ አትተወኝ፤ \q ክንድህን [ለሚቀጥለው] ትውልድ እስክናገር ድረስ፤ \q ኃይልህንም ለሚመጡት ሁሉ።
am.B: አሁን ባረጀሁና በሸበትሁ ጊዜ፣ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ አትተወኝ፤ \q ክንድህ ያደረገውን ከእኔ በኋላ ላለው ትውልድ እስክነግር ድረስ፣ \q ኃይልህንም ገና ለሚወለዱት ሁሉ እስካሳውቅ ድረስ።
am.R: አሁን አርጅቻለሁ፤ ጠጉሬም ሸብቷል። እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ አትተወኝ። \q አስቀድሜ ምን ያህል ብርቱ እንደ ሆንክ ለወጣቶች ልንገር። \q ከእኔ በኋላ ለሚመጡት ሁሉ ስለ ኃይልህ ልንገራቸው።

hi.L: और बुढ़ापे और पके बालों तक भी, हे परमेश्वर, मुझे न छोड़, \q जब तक मैं [अगली] पीढ़ी को तेरी भुजा का वर्णन न कर दूँ, \q आनेवाले सब लोगों को तेरा पराक्रम।
hi.B: अब जब मैं बूढ़ा हो गया हूँ और मेरे बाल पक गए हैं, हे परमेश्वर, मुझे न त्याग, \q जब तक मैं अपने बाद की पीढ़ी को न बता दूँ कि तेरी भुजा ने क्या किया है, \q और जो अभी जन्मे भी नहीं, उन सब पर तेरी सामर्थ्य प्रकट न कर दूँ।
hi.R: अब मैं बूढ़ा हो गया हूँ और मेरे बाल सफ़ेद हो गए हैं। हे परमेश्वर, मुझे न छोड़। \q पहले मुझे जवान लोगों को बताने दे कि तू कितना सामर्थी है। \q मेरे बाद आनेवाले सब लोगों को मुझे तेरी शक्ति के बारे में बताने दे।

ru.L: И до старости и седины, Боже, не оставь меня, \q пока не возвещу мышцу {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} [следующему] поколению, \q силу {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} — всем грядущим.
ru.B: Теперь, когда я стар и сед, Боже, не покидай меня, \q пока я не расскажу поколению после меня, что совершила {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} рука, \q и не открою {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} мощь всем, кто ещё родится.
ru.R: Теперь я стар, и волосы мои седы. Боже, не оставляй меня. \q Позволь мне сначала рассказать молодым, как {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} силён. \q Позволь мне рассказать всем, кто будет жить после меня, о {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} силе.

ja.L: また、老いて白髪になるまでも、神よ、わたしを見捨てないでください、 \q わたしがあなたの腕を[次の]世代に告げ知らせるまで、 \q 来るべきすべての者に、あなたの力を。
ja.B: 年老いて白髪になった今も、神よ、わたしを見捨てないでください。 \q わたしが、あとに続く世代に、あなたの腕のなさったことを語り、 \q これから生まれるすべての人に、あなたの力を知らせるまでは。
ja.R: わたしは年を取り、髪も白くなった。神よ、わたしを見捨てないでください。 \q まず、若い人たちに、あなたがどんなに強い方かを話させてください。 \q わたしのあとに来るすべての人に、あなたの力について話させてください。

decisions.choice: your arm: your strength in action
decisions.reason: God's arm is a picture of his power to act and to save (44:4; 77:16).

decisions.choice: to a generation, to all who will come: to those who come after
decisions.reason: "A generation" here is the next one, and "all who will come" are those still to be born (22:31-32; 78:4-6). The old man asks to live until he has passed on what God has done.

decisions.choice: the next (L); after me (B); young (R)
decisions.reason: The sense of "a generation" (m2) is made plain at each level.

decisions.choice: zero'akha "あなたの腕" (L, B; B "腕のなさったこと"), "どんなに強い方か" (R)
decisions.reason: The arm is God's strength in action (m1); B and R say what the arm does, as the English.

source.text: וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ אֱלֹהִ֗ים עַד־מָ֫ר֥וֹם אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂ֥יתָ גְדֹל֑וֹת אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים מִ֣י כָמֽוֹךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And your righteousness, God, [is] to [the] height, who have done great things; God, who [is] like you?

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} righteousness, God, [reaches] to the heights, \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} who have done great things; \q God, who [is] like {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}?
en.B: God, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} righteousness rises as high as the heavens; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done mighty things. \q God, who is there like {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}?
en.R: God, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} goodness is higher than the sky. \q You have done great things. \q God, no one is like {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}!

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} justice, ô Dieu, [atteint] jusqu’aux hauteurs, \q {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui as fait de grandes choses ; \q ô Dieu, qui [est] comme {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ?
fr.B: Ô Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} justice s’élève jusqu’aux cieux ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait de grandes choses. \q Ô Dieu, qui est semblable à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ?
fr.R: Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bonté est plus haute que le ciel. \q Tu as fait de grandes choses. \q Dieu, personne n’est comme {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} !

sw.L: Na haki {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, Ee Mungu, [inafika] hata mbinguni juu, \q {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uliyetenda mambo makuu; \q Ee Mungu, ni nani [aliye] kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}?
sw.B: Ee Mungu, haki {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} inapanda juu hata mbinguni; \q {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umetenda mambo makuu. \q Ee Mungu, ni nani aliye kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}?
sw.R: Mungu, wema {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} uko juu kuliko anga. \q Umetenda mambo makuu. \q Mungu, hakuna aliye kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}!

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} justicia, oh Dios, [llega] hasta las alturas, \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} que has hecho grandes cosas; \q oh Dios, ¿quién [es] como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}?
es.B: Oh Dios, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} justicia se eleva hasta los cielos; \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho cosas grandiosas. \q Oh Dios, ¿quién hay como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}?
es.R: Dios, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} bondad es más alta que el cielo. \q Tú has hecho grandes cosas. \q Dios, ¡nadie es como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}!

vi.L: Và sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy Đức Chúa Trời, [vươn] đến tận nơi cao, \q [hỡi] {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng đã làm những việc lớn lao; \q lạy Đức Chúa Trời, ai [giống] như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?
vi.B: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cao đến tận các tầng trời; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm những việc vĩ đại. \q Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, có ai giống như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?
vi.R: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, sự tốt lành của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cao hơn cả bầu trời. \q Ngài đã làm những việc lớn lao. \q Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, không ai giống như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!

ko.L: 하나님, 주님의 의는 높은 곳까지 [닿습니다]. \q 큰일들을 행하신 주님, \q 하나님, 누가 주님과 같겠습니까?
ko.B: 하나님, 주님의 의는 하늘 높이 솟아 있습니다. \q 주님께서는 큰일들을 행하셨습니다. \q 하나님, 누가 주님과 같겠습니까?
ko.R: 하나님, 주님의 선하심은 하늘보다 높습니다. \q 주님께서는 위대한 일들을 하셨습니다. \q 하나님, 주님 같은 분은 아무도 없습니다!

pt.L: E a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} justiça, Deus, [chega] até as alturas, \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} que fizeste grandes coisas; \q Deus, quem [é] como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}?
pt.B: Deus, a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} justiça se eleva até os céus; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste coisas grandiosas. \q Deus, quem há como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}?
pt.R: Deus, a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} bondade é mais alta que o céu. \q Tu fizeste grandes coisas. \q Deus, ninguém é como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}!

am.L: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ጽድቅህም እስከ ከፍታ [ይደርሳል]፤ \q ታላላቅ ነገሮችን ያደረግህ [አንተ]፤ \q እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ እንደ አንተ ማን ነው?
am.B: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ጽድቅህ እስከ ሰማያት ከፍ ይላል፤ \q ታላላቅ ነገሮችን አድርገሃል። \q እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ እንደ አንተ ያለ ማን አለ?
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ቸርነትህ ከሰማይ በላይ ከፍ ያለ ነው። \q ታላላቅ ነገሮችን አድርገሃል። \q እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ እንደ አንተ ያለ ማንም የለም!

hi.L: और हे परमेश्वर, तेरी धार्मिकता ऊँचाइयों तक [पहुँचती है], \q तू जिसने बड़े-बड़े काम किए हैं; \q हे परमेश्वर, तेरे समान कौन [है]?
hi.B: हे परमेश्वर, तेरी धार्मिकता आकाश जितनी ऊँची है; \q तूने महान काम किए हैं। \q हे परमेश्वर, तेरे समान कौन है?
hi.R: हे परमेश्वर, तेरी भलाई आकाश से भी ऊँची है। \q तूने बड़े-बड़े काम किए हैं। \q हे परमेश्वर, तेरे समान कोई नहीं!

ru.L: И праведность {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}}, Боже, — до высот, \q [{{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}},] сотворивший великое; \q Боже, кто подобен {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}?
ru.B: Боже, {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} праведность поднимается до небес; \q {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} совершил великие дела. \q Боже, кто подобен {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}?
ru.R: Боже, {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} доброта выше неба. \q Ты совершил великие дела. \q Боже, никто не сравнится с {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}}!

ja.L: また、あなたの義は、神よ、高い天に[届く]。 \q 大いなることをなさったあなた。 \q 神よ、だれがあなたのようであろうか？
ja.B: 神よ、あなたの義は、天の高みにまで届く。 \q あなたは大いなることをなさった。 \q 神よ、だれがあなたに並ぶだろうか？
ja.R: 神よ、あなたの正しさは、空よりも高い。 \q あなたは偉大なことをなさった。 \q 神よ、あなたのような方は、だれもいない！

decisions.choice: the height: the heavens
decisions.reason: The word (marom) is the high place, the heavens where God is (7:8; 93:4).

decisions.choice: who is like you: God has no equal
decisions.reason: The question echoes the song at the sea (Exodus 15:11) and 35:10; it expects the answer "no one".

decisions.choice: no one is like you!
decisions.reason: Readable gives the answer the question expects (m2).

decisions.choice: mi khamokha as a statement "あなたのような方は、だれもいない！" (R), a question at L, B
decisions.reason: The question means that God has no equal (m2); R says it as the English R does.

source.text: אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִרְאִיתַ֨נִי׀צָר֥וֹת רַבּ֗וֹת וְרָ֫ע֥וֹת תָּשׁ֥וּב תְּחַיֵּ֑ינִי וּֽמִתְּהֹמ֥וֹת הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ תָּשׁ֥וּב תַּעֲלֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: [You] who have made me see troubles, many and evil, you will turn, you will give me life, and from [the] depths of the earth you will turn, you will bring me up.

en.L: You who have made me see troubles many and evil \q will again give me life, \q and from the depths of the earth {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will again bring me up.
en.B: You have made me see many troubles and hard times, \q but {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will bring me back to life, \q and raise me once more out of the deep places of the earth.
en.R: You have let me go through many hard and painful times. \q But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will make me live again. \q You will lift me up again, as if from deep under the earth.

fr.L: Toi qui m’as fait voir des détresses nombreuses et mauvaises, \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me rendras encore la vie, \q et des abîmes de la terre {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me feras encore remonter.
fr.B: Tu m’as fait voir beaucoup de détresses et de malheurs, \q mais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me rendras la vie \q et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me feras remonter encore des profondeurs de la terre.
fr.R: Tu m’as laissé traverser beaucoup de moments durs et douloureux. \q Mais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me feras vivre de nouveau. \q Tu me relèveras encore, comme si {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me tirais du fond de la terre.

sw.L: Wewe uliyenionyesha taabu nyingi na mabaya \q utanihuisha tena, \q na kutoka vilindi vya nchi {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} utanipandisha tena.
sw.B: Umenifanya nione taabu nyingi na nyakati ngumu, \q lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} utanirudishia uhai, \q na kunipandisha tena kutoka vilindi vya nchi.
sw.R: Umeniacha nipitie nyakati nyingi ngumu na zenye maumivu. \q Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} utanifanya niishi tena. \q Utaniinua tena, kana kwamba kutoka chini kabisa ya ardhi.

es.L: Tú, que me has hecho ver angustias muchas y malas, \q me volverás a dar vida, \q y de las profundidades de la tierra {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me volverás a subir.
es.B: Tú me has hecho ver muchas angustias y tiempos difíciles, \q pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me devolverás la vida, \q y me levantarás de nuevo de lo profundo de la tierra.
es.R: Tú has dejado que yo pase por muchos momentos duros y dolorosos. \q Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me harás vivir otra vez. \q Me volverás a levantar, como si me sacaras de lo hondo de la tierra.

vi.L: Ngài là Đấng đã cho tôi thấy những gian truân nhiều và dữ dội, \q sẽ lại cho tôi được sống, \q và từ những vực sâu của đất, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ lại đem tôi lên.
vi.B: Ngài đã để tôi thấy nhiều gian truân và hoạn nạn, \q nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ cho tôi sống lại, \q và một lần nữa đem tôi lên khỏi những nơi sâu thẳm của đất.
vi.R: Ngài đã để tôi trải qua nhiều thời gian khó khăn và đau đớn. \q Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ cho tôi được sống lại. \q Ngài sẽ nâng tôi lên lần nữa, như thể từ sâu dưới lòng đất.

ko.L: 많은 고난과 재앙을 저에게 보게 하신 주님께서 \q 다시 저를 살리시고, \q 땅의 깊은 곳에서 다시 저를 끌어올리실 것입니다.
ko.B: 주님께서는 저에게 많은 고난과 어려움을 겪게 하셨지만, \q 저를 다시 살리시고, \q 땅속 깊은 곳에서 다시 끌어올리실 것입니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 제가 힘들고 괴로운 일을 많이 겪게 하셨습니다. \q 그러나 주님께서 저를 다시 살게 하실 것입니다. \q 땅속 깊은 곳에서 끌어올리듯 저를 다시 일으키실 것입니다.

pt.L: Tu, que me fizeste ver angústias muitas e más, \q de novo me darás vida, \q e das profundezas da terra {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} de novo me farás subir.
pt.B: Tu me fizeste ver muitas angústias e tempos difíceis, \q mas {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me trarás de volta à vida \q e me levantarás outra vez das profundezas da terra.
pt.R: Tu me deixaste passar por muitos momentos difíceis e dolorosos. \q Mas {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} vais me fazer viver de novo. \q Tu vais me levantar outra vez, como se me tirasses do fundo da terra.

am.L: ብዙና ክፉ መከራዎችን ያሳየኸኝ [አንተ] \q እንደ ገና ሕያው ታደርገኛለህ፤ \q ከምድር ጥልቅም እንደ ገና ታወጣኛለህ።
am.B: ብዙ መከራንና ክፉ ጊዜን አሳይተኸኛል፤ \q ነገር ግን እንደ ገና ሕያው ታደርገኛለህ፤ \q ከምድርም ጥልቅ ስፍራዎች ዳግመኛ ታወጣኛለህ።
am.R: በብዙ አስቸጋሪና አሳማሚ ጊዜያት እንዳልፍ ፈቅደሃል። \q አንተ ግን እንደ ገና ሕያው ታደርገኛለህ። \q ከምድር በታች ካለ ጥልቅ ስፍራ ያህል እንደ ገና ታወጣኛለህ።

hi.L: तू, जिसने मुझे बहुत से और बुरे संकट दिखाए हैं, \q मुझे फिर से जीवन देगा, \q और पृथ्वी की गहराइयों से तू मुझे फिर ऊपर ले आएगा।
hi.B: तूने मुझे बहुत से संकट और कठिन समय दिखाए हैं, \q पर तू मुझे फिर से जीवित करेगा, \q और पृथ्वी के गहरे स्थानों से मुझे एक बार फिर ऊपर उठाएगा।
hi.R: तूने मुझे बहुत से कठिन और दुख भरे समयों से गुज़रने दिया है। \q पर तू मुझे फिर से जीवन देगा। \q तू मुझे फिर ऊपर उठाएगा, मानो पृथ्वी के बहुत नीचे से।

ru.L: Ты, давший мне увидеть беды многие и злые, \q снова оживишь меня \q и из бездн земли снова выведешь меня.
ru.B: Ты дал мне увидеть много бед и тяжёлых времён, \q но {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} вернёшь меня к жизни \q и снова поднимешь меня из глубин земли.
ru.R: Ты позволил мне пройти через много тяжёлых и горьких времён. \q Но {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} снова дашь мне жизнь. \q Ты снова поднимешь меня, будто из глубины под землёй.

ja.L: 多くの苦難と災いをわたしにお見せになったあなたは、 \q 再びわたしを生かし、 \q 地の深みから、再びわたしを引き上げてくださる。
ja.B: あなたは、多くの苦しみと災いをわたしに経験させた。 \q しかし、あなたは再びわたしを生かし、 \q 地の深い所から、もう一度引き上げてくださる。
ja.R: あなたは、わたしに、つらく苦しい時をたくさん通らせた。 \q しかし、あなたは、わたしをもう一度生かしてくださる。 \q 地の深い底からのように、わたしをもう一度引き上げてくださる。

decisions.choice: me: the words as read, not as written
decisions.reason: Two of the verbs are written with "us" ("made us see", "give us life") but marked to be read with "me", which fits the rest of the psalm and the last verb, "bring me up". The words follow the form to be read.

decisions.choice: you will turn: you will do it again
decisions.reason: "Turn" (shuv) before another verb means to do it again: God will once more give life and lift him up.

decisions.choice: the depths of the earth: the realm of death
decisions.reason: The depths (tehomot) below the earth stand for death and the grave (30:4; 88:7). To be brought up from there is to be rescued from dying.

decisions.choice: as if
decisions.reason: Readable makes plain that the depths are a picture (m3).

decisions.choice: "me" (L "わたしに", "わたしを") as read (m1); tashuv "再び" / "もう一度" (m2); "お見せになった" (L), plain causatives "経験させた" / "通らせた" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The words as read say "me" where the written text says "us" (m1, uncertain); "you will turn" means doing it again (m2); the depths of the earth are the realm of death (m3), R "のように" as the English "as if". A causative stays plain for God (PSA-1).

source.text: תֶּ֤רֶב׀גְּֽדֻלָּתִ֗י וְתִסֹּ֥ב תְּֽנַחֲמֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: May you increase my greatness, and you will turn [and] comfort me.

en.L: May {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} increase my greatness, \q and turn [and] comfort me.
en.B: Make me greater than before, \q and turn to comfort me once more.
en.R: Give me even more honor than I had before. \q Comfort me again.

fr.L: Puisses-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} accroître ma grandeur, \q et revenir [et] me consoler.
fr.B: Rends-moi plus grand qu’avant, \q et reviens me consoler.
fr.R: Donne-moi encore plus d’honneur qu’avant. \q Console-moi de nouveau.

sw.L: Uuongeze ukuu wangu, \q ugeuke [na] kunifariji.
sw.B: Unifanye mkuu kuliko hapo awali, \q na unigeukie kunifariji tena.
sw.R: Unipe heshima kubwa kuliko niliyokuwa nayo. \q Unifariji tena.

es.L: Que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} aumentes mi grandeza, \q y vuelvas [a] consolarme.
es.B: Hazme más grande que antes, \q y vuelve a consolarme una vez más.
es.R: Dame aún más honra de la que tenía antes. \q Consuélame otra vez.

vi.L: Nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm tăng thêm sự cao trọng của tôi, \q và quay lại [mà] an ủi tôi.
vi.B: Xin làm cho tôi được tôn trọng hơn trước, \q và quay lại an ủi tôi một lần nữa.
vi.R: Xin cho tôi được tôn trọng hơn trước kia. \q Xin an ủi tôi một lần nữa.

ko.L: 주님께서 저의 위대함을 더하시고, \q 다시 [돌이켜] 저를 위로하여 주십시오.
ko.B: 저를 전보다 더 크게 하시고, \q 다시 돌아오셔서 저를 위로하여 주십시오.
ko.R: 전보다 더 큰 영예를 저에게 주십시오. \q 저를 다시 위로해 주십시오.

pt.L: Que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} aumentes a minha grandeza, \q e voltes [e] me consoles.
pt.B: Torna-me maior do que antes \q e volta-{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} para me consolar mais uma vez.
pt.R: Dá-me ainda mais honra do que eu tinha antes. \q Consola-me de novo.

am.L: ታላቅነቴን አብዛ፤ \q ተመልሰህም አጽናናኝ።
am.B: ከቀድሞው ይበልጥ ታላቅ አድርገኝ፤ \q ዳግመኛም ተመልሰህ አጽናናኝ።
am.R: ከበፊቱ የበለጠ ክብር ስጠኝ። \q እንደ ገና አጽናናኝ።

hi.L: तू मेरी महानता बढ़ाए, \q और फिरकर मुझे शांति दे।
hi.B: मुझे पहले से भी बड़ा बना, \q और फिर से मेरी ओर मुड़कर मुझे शांति दे।
hi.R: मुझे पहले से भी अधिक सम्मान दे। \q मुझे फिर से शांति दे।

ru.L: Умножь величие моё \q и обратись, утешь меня.
ru.B: Сделай меня ещё больше, чем прежде, \q и снова обратись ко мне с утешением.
ru.R: Дай мне ещё больше чести, чем было у меня прежде. \q Снова утешь меня.

ja.L: わたしの大いさを増し加えてください。 \q 振り向いて、わたしを慰めてください。
ja.B: わたしを以前よりも大いなる者としてください。 \q もう一度、わたしの方を向いて、慰めてください。
ja.R: 前よりももっと、わたしに誉れを与えてください。 \q もう一度、わたしを慰めてください。

decisions.choice: my greatness: my honor and standing
decisions.reason: The word (gedullah) is greatness or honor; he asks that his standing be restored and increased, against those who say God has left him (verse 11).

decisions.choice: you will turn and comfort me: comfort me again
decisions.reason: As in verse 20, "turn" means to do it again, or to turn toward him.

decisions.choice: The wish made a request "〜てください" at every level; gedullati "わたしの大いさ" (L), "大いなる者" (B), "誉れ" (R)
decisions.reason: "May you increase" is a wish spoken to God, which the Psalter puts as a request (PSA-1); "my greatness" is honor and standing (m1); "turn and comfort" is comforting again (m2).

source.text: גַּם־אֲנִ֤י׀אוֹדְךָ֣ בִכְלִי־נֶבֶל֮ אֲמִתְּךָ֪ אֱלֹ֫הָ֥י אֲזַמְּרָ֣ה לְךָ֣ בְכִנּ֑וֹר קְ֝ד֗וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: I also will praise you with an instrument of harp, your faithfulness, my God; I will make music to you with [the] lyre, Holy One of Israel.

en.L: I also will praise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} with an instrument of harp, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithfulness, my God; \q I will make music to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} with [the] lyre, \q Holy One of Israel.
en.B: I in turn will thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to the music of the harp; my God, I will praise {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithfulness. \q With the lyre I will play for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, \q Holy One of Israel.
en.R: My God, I will play the harp and thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} keep {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} promises. \q Holy God of Israel, I will play the lyre and sing to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Moi aussi je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louerai avec l’instrument de la harpe, [pour] {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fidélité, mon Dieu ; \q je jouerai pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} sur la lyre, \q Saint d’Israël.
fr.B: À mon tour, je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendrai grâce au son de la harpe ; mon Dieu, je chanterai {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fidélité. \q Sur la lyre je jouerai pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, \q Saint d’Israël.
fr.R: Mon Dieu, je jouerai de la harpe pour {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercier, car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} tiens {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} promesses. \q Dieu saint d’Israël, je jouerai de la lyre et je chanterai pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Mimi nami nitakusifu kwa chombo cha zeze, uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, Ee Mungu wangu; \q nitakuimbia {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} kwa kinubi, \q Ee Mtakatifu wa Israeli.
sw.B: Nami kwa upande wangu nitakushukuru kwa muziki wa zeze; Ee Mungu wangu, nitausifu uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}. \q Kwa kinubi nitakupigia {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, \q Ee Mtakatifu wa Israeli.
sw.R: Mungu wangu, nitapiga zeze na kukushukuru kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} hutimiza ahadi {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}. \q Mungu Mtakatifu wa Israeli, nitapiga kinubi na kukuimbia {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}.

es.L: Yo también {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} alabaré con instrumento de arpa, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fidelidad, Dios mío; \q {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} cantaré con [la] lira, \q Santo de Israel.
es.B: Yo, por mi parte, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} daré gracias al son del arpa; Dios mío, alabaré {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fidelidad. \q Con la lira tocaré para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, \q Santo de Israel.
es.R: Dios mío, tocaré el arpa y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} daré gracias porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} cumples {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} promesas. \q Santo Dios de Israel, tocaré la lira y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} cantaré.

vi.L: Tôi cũng sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bằng nhạc cụ đàn hạc, [ca ngợi] sự thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi ơi; \q tôi sẽ đàn hát cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bằng đàn lia, \q lạy Đấng Thánh của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Về phần tôi, tôi sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} theo tiếng đàn hạc; Đức Chúa Trời của tôi ơi, tôi sẽ ca ngợi sự thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Tôi sẽ gảy đàn lia dâng lên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q lạy Đấng Thánh của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời của tôi ơi, tôi sẽ chơi đàn hạc và cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữ lời hứa của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Lạy Đức Chúa Trời thánh khiết của Y-sơ-ra-ên, tôi sẽ chơi đàn lia và hát cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 저도 하프의 악기로 주님을, 주님의 신실하심을 찬양하겠습니다, 나의 하나님. \q 수금으로 주님께 노래하겠습니다, \q 이스라엘의 거룩하신 분이여.
ko.B: 저도 하프 소리에 맞추어 주님께 감사하겠습니다. 나의 하나님, 주님의 신실하심을 찬양하겠습니다. \q 수금을 타며 주님께 노래하겠습니다, \q 이스라엘의 거룩하신 분이여.
ko.R: 나의 하나님, 주님께서는 약속을 지키시니, 저는 하프를 타며 주님께 감사하겠습니다. \q 이스라엘의 거룩하신 하나님, 저는 수금을 타며 주님께 노래하겠습니다.

pt.L: Também eu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louvarei com instrumento de harpa, a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} fidelidade, meu Deus; \q cantarei louvores a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} com [a] lira, \q Santo de Israel.
pt.B: Eu, por minha vez, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} darei graças ao som da harpa; meu Deus, louvarei a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} fidelidade. \q Com a lira tocarei para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, \q Santo de Israel.
pt.R: Meu Deus, vou tocar harpa e {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} agradecer, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} cumpres as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} promessas. \q Deus Santo de Israel, vou tocar a lira e cantar para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

am.L: እኔም ደግሞ በመሰንቆ መሣሪያ አመሰግንሃለሁ፤ አምላኬ ሆይ፣ ታማኝነትህን [አመሰግናለሁ]፤ \q በበገና እዘምርልሃለሁ፤ \q የእስራኤል ቅዱስ ሆይ።
am.B: እኔም በተራዬ በመሰንቆ ዜማ አመሰግንሃለሁ፤ አምላኬ ሆይ፣ ታማኝነትህን አወድሳለሁ። \q በበገና እዘምርልሃለሁ፤ \q የእስራኤል ቅዱስ ሆይ።
am.R: አምላኬ ሆይ፣ የተስፋ ቃልህን ስለምትጠብቅ መሰንቆ እየመታሁ አመሰግንሃለሁ። \q የእስራኤል ቅዱስ አምላክ ሆይ፣ በገና እየደረደርሁ እዘምርልሃለሁ።

hi.L: मैं भी सारंगी के बाजे से तेरी, तेरी सच्चाई की, स्तुति करूँगा, हे मेरे परमेश्वर; \q मैं वीणा बजाकर तेरी स्तुति करूँगा, \q हे इस्राएल के पवित्र।
hi.B: मैं भी सारंगी के संगीत के साथ तेरा धन्यवाद करूँगा; हे मेरे परमेश्वर, मैं तेरी विश्वासयोग्यता की स्तुति करूँगा। \q वीणा पर मैं तेरे लिए बजाऊँगा, \q हे इस्राएल के पवित्र।
hi.R: हे मेरे परमेश्वर, मैं सारंगी बजाकर तेरा धन्यवाद करूँगा, क्योंकि तू अपनी प्रतिज्ञाएँ पूरी करता है। \q हे इस्राएल के पवित्र परमेश्वर, मैं वीणा बजाकर तेरे लिए गाऊँगा।

ru.L: И я буду славить {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} на инструменте арфы, верность {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}}, Боже мой; \q буду воспевать {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} на лире, \q Святой Израиля.
ru.B: И я, в свою очередь, буду благодарить {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} под звуки арфы; Боже мой, я буду хвалить {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} верность. \q Я буду играть для {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} на лире, \q Святой Израиля.
ru.R: Боже мой, я буду играть на арфе и благодарить {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} за то, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} исполняешь свои обещания. \q Святой Бог Израиля, я буду играть на лире и петь {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.

ja.L: わたしもまた、琴という楽器で、あなたに感謝しよう、あなたのまことを、わたしの神よ。 \q 竪琴で、あなたにほめ歌を歌おう、 \q イスラエルの聖なる方よ。
ja.B: わたしもまた、琴に合わせて、あなたに感謝をささげる。わたしの神よ、あなたのまことをたたえよう。 \q 竪琴で、あなたにほめ歌を歌おう、 \q イスラエルの聖なる方よ。
ja.R: わたしの神よ、わたしは琴をひいて、あなたに感謝しよう。あなたは約束を守ってくださるから。 \q イスラエルの聖なる神よ、わたしはたて琴をひいて、あなたに歌おう。

decisions.choice: harp and lyre: two stringed instruments
decisions.reason: As in 33:2: the kinnor was a light lyre held in the hands; the nevel a larger harp.

decisions.choice: the Holy One of Israel
decisions.reason: This title for God is used often in Isaiah (Isaiah 1:4; 6:3) and only three times in the Psalms (71:22; 78:41; 89:19). It names God as holy, set apart from all, and yet bound to Israel.

decisions.choice: because you keep your promises
decisions.reason: Readable says what God's faithfulness ('emet) means for the speaker.

decisions.choice: Holy God of Israel
decisions.reason: Readable uses "God" so that the title is plain.

decisions.choice: "đàn hạc" (harp) and "đàn lia" (lyre)
decisions.reason: Two stringed instruments (see the meaning decision); "đàn hạc" and "đàn lia" are the plain modern names for a harp and a lyre, where the older "đàn cầm", "đàn sắt" are Sino-Vietnamese literary words few readers can picture.

decisions.choice: "하프" for nevel and "수금" for kinnor
decisions.reason: Two stringed instruments (meaning decision); "하프" and "수금" keep them apart in words a modern reader knows, without naming a Korean instrument.

decisions.choice: harp (nevel) as "መሰንቆ", lyre (kinnor) as "በገና"
decisions.reason: The two stringed instruments keep the Amharic names they have in 2 Samuel 6:5 and Psalm 33:2 on main.

decisions.choice: "सारंगी" (harp), "वीणा" (lyre); "इस्राएल के पवित्र" (L, B), "इस्राएल के पवित्र परमेश्वर" (R)
decisions.reason: The two instruments (meaning m1) keep the Hindi words of 1 Chronicles 15:16 and Psalm 33:2 in this translation: nevel "सारंगी", kinnor "वीणा". The Holy One of Israel (meaning m2) is "इस्राएल का पवित्र" in the poetry note; Readable adds "God", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "सच्चाई" (L), "विश्वासयोग्यता" (B)
decisions.reason: God's faithfulness ('emet) is "सच्चाई" at Literal and "विश्वासयोग्यता" at Balanced, as the poetry note sets; Readable says what it means for the speaker, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Святой Израиля"
decisions.reason: The note's form for "the Holy One of Israel", in modern Russian; Readable says "Святой Бог Израиля", as the English Readable names God.

decisions.choice: nevel "琴", kinnor "竪琴" (L, B), "たて琴" (R), as 33:2; qedosh Yisra'el "イスラエルの聖なる方" (L, B), "イスラエルの聖なる神" (R); 'amitt'kha "あなたのまこと" (L, B), "約束を守ってくださる" (R)
decisions.reason: The two stringed instruments (m1) keep the Psalter's words; the Holy One of Israel (m2) takes the form used in the Japanese drafts of Isaiah and 2 Kings.

source.text: תְּרַנֵּ֣נָּ֣ה שְׂ֭פָתַי כִּ֣י אֲזַמְּרָה־לָּ֑ךְ וְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּדִֽיתָ׃

records.literal_gloss: My lips will shout for joy when I make music to you, and my soul, which you have redeemed.

en.L: My lips will shout for joy when I make music to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, \q and my soul, which {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have redeemed.
en.B: My lips will ring out with joy as I sing {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} praise, \q and so will my whole self, which {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have set free.
en.R: I will shout for joy as I sing to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q With my whole heart I will sing, because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have rescued me.

fr.L: Mes lèvres crieront de joie quand je jouerai pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, \q et mon âme, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as rachetée.
fr.B: Mes lèvres éclateront de joie quand je chanterai {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} louange, \q et tout mon être aussi, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as libéré.
fr.R: Je crierai de joie en chantant pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. \q Je chanterai de tout mon cœur, car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as sauvé.

sw.L: Midomo yangu itapiga kelele kwa furaha nikuimbiapo {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, \q na nafsi yangu, ambayo {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umeikomboa.
sw.B: Midomo yangu itavuma kwa furaha ninapoimba sifa {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, \q na vivyo hivyo nafsi yangu yote, ambayo {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umeiweka huru.
sw.R: Nitapiga kelele kwa furaha ninapokuimbia {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}. \q Nitaimba kwa moyo wangu wote, kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umeniokoa.

es.L: Mis labios gritarán de júbilo cuando {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} cante, \q y mi alma, que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has redimido.
es.B: Mis labios gritarán de alegría mientras canto {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} alabanzas, \q y también todo mi ser, que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has puesto en libertad.
es.R: Gritaré de alegría mientras {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} canto. \q Cantaré con todo el corazón, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me has rescatado.

vi.L: Môi tôi sẽ reo vui khi tôi đàn hát cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và linh hồn tôi, là [linh hồn] {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cứu chuộc.
vi.B: Môi tôi sẽ reo vui khi tôi hát ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và cả con người tôi, mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giải thoát, cũng reo vui.
vi.R: Tôi sẽ reo vui khi hát cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Tôi sẽ hát hết lòng, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giải cứu tôi.

ko.L: 제가 주님께 노래할 때 제 입술이 기뻐 외치고, \q 주님께서 속량하신 제 영혼도 [그러할 것입니다].
ko.B: 제가 주님을 찬양할 때 제 입술이 기쁨으로 소리치고, \q 주님께서 건져 내신 제 온 존재도 그러할 것입니다.
ko.R: 제가 주님께 노래할 때 기뻐서 소리치겠습니다. \q 주님께서 저를 구해 주셨으니 온 마음으로 노래하겠습니다.

pt.L: Os meus lábios gritarão de alegria quando eu cantar louvores a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, \q e a minha alma, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} resgataste.
pt.B: Os meus lábios vão ressoar de alegria enquanto canto o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} louvor, \q e também todo o meu ser, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} libertaste.
pt.R: Vou gritar de alegria enquanto canto para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. \q Vou cantar de todo o coração, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me salvaste.

am.L: ስዘምርልህ ከንፈሮቼ እልል ይላሉ፤ \q የዋጀሃትም ነፍሴ [እልል ትላለች]።
am.B: ምስጋናህን ስዘምር ከንፈሮቼ በደስታ ይጮኻሉ፤ \q ነጻ ያወጣኸው ሁለንተናዬም እንዲሁ።
am.R: ስዘምርልህ በደስታ እልል እላለሁ። \q አድነኸኛልና በሙሉ ልቤ እዘምራለሁ።

hi.L: जब मैं बाजा बजाकर तेरी स्तुति करूँगा, तब मेरे होंठ जयजयकार करेंगे, \q और मेरा प्राण भी, जिसे तूने मोल देकर छुड़ाया है।
hi.B: जब मैं तेरी स्तुति गाऊँगा, तब मेरे होंठ आनंद से गूँज उठेंगे, \q और मेरा पूरा अस्तित्व भी, जिसे तूने स्वतंत्र किया है।
hi.R: जब मैं तेरे लिए गाऊँगा, तब आनंद से जयजयकार करूँगा। \q मैं पूरे मन से गाऊँगा, क्योंकि तूने मुझे छुड़ाया है।

ru.L: Будут ликовать уста мои, когда я воспеваю {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}, \q и душа моя, которую {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} искупил.
ru.B: Мои уста будут радостно звенеть, когда я пою {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} хвалу, \q и всё моё существо, которое {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} освободил.
ru.R: Я буду радостно кричать, когда пою {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}. \q Всем сердцем я буду петь, потому что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} спас меня.

ja.L: わたしの唇は喜び歌う、わたしがあなたにほめ歌を歌うとき、 \q また、あなたが贖ってくださったわたしの魂も。
ja.B: あなたにほめ歌を歌うとき、わたしの唇は喜びの声を上げる。 \q あなたが救い出してくださったわたし自身も、喜び歌う。
ja.R: あなたに歌うとき、わたしは喜びの声を上げる。 \q あなたが助け出してくださったから、わたしは心から歌う。

decisions.choice: redeemed: set free at a cost
decisions.reason: The verb (padah) is used for buying back a person or a firstborn, and for God's rescue of Israel from Egypt (Deuteronomy 7:8); here it is his rescue of the speaker (31:6).

decisions.choice: my whole self (B); my whole heart (R)
decisions.reason: "My soul" (nefesh) is the whole person.

decisions.choice: padita "贖ってくださった" (L), "救い出してくださった" (B), "助け出してくださった" (R); nafshi "わたしの魂" (L), "わたし自身" (B), "心から" (R)
decisions.reason: Redeemed is set free at a cost (m1); the Psalter's padah is 贖う at L and 救い出す at B, R (PSA-1).

source.text: גַּם־לְשׁוֹנִ֗י כָּל־הַ֭יּוֹם תֶּהְגֶּ֣ה צִדְקָתֶ֑ךָ כִּי־בֹ֥שׁוּ כִֽי־חָ֝פְר֗וּ מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י רָעָתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Also my tongue all the day will murmur your righteousness, for they are ashamed, for they are abashed, those who seek my harm.

en.L: My tongue also will talk all the day [of] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} righteousness, \q for they are put to shame, for they are abashed, those who seek my harm.
en.B: All day long my tongue will speak of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} righteousness, \q for the people who sought my hurt are ashamed and humbled.
en.R: All day long I will talk about how {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do what is right. \q The people who wanted to hurt me are ashamed and disgraced.

fr.L: Ma langue aussi parlera tout le jour [de] {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} justice, \q car ils sont couverts de honte, car ils sont confus, ceux qui cherchent mon malheur.
fr.B: Tout au long du jour ma langue dira {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} justice, \q car ceux qui cherchaient mon malheur sont honteux et humiliés.
fr.R: Toute la journée, je dirai comment {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais ce qui est juste. \q Ceux qui voulaient me faire du mal ont honte et sont déshonorés.

sw.L: Ulimi wangu nao utanena mchana kutwa [juu ya] haki {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, \q kwa maana wameaibishwa, kwa maana wamefadhaika, wale wanaotafuta madhara yangu.
sw.B: Mchana kutwa ulimi wangu utanena juu ya haki {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, \q kwa maana watu waliotafuta kunidhuru wameaibika na kunyenyekezwa.
sw.R: Mchana kutwa nitazungumza juu ya jinsi {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unavyotenda haki. \q Watu waliotaka kunidhuru wameaibika na kufedheheka.

es.L: También mi lengua hablará todo el día [de] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} justicia, \q porque han sido avergonzados, porque han sido confundidos los que buscan mi mal.
es.B: Todo el día mi lengua hablará de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} justicia, \q porque los que buscaban mi daño están avergonzados y humillados.
es.R: Todo el día hablaré de cómo {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} haces lo correcto. \q Los que querían hacerme daño están avergonzados y humillados.

vi.L: Lưỡi tôi cũng sẽ suốt ngày nói [về] sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q vì chúng bị hổ thẹn, vì chúng bị bối rối, những kẻ tìm điều ác cho tôi.
vi.B: Suốt ngày lưỡi tôi sẽ nói về sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q vì những kẻ tìm hại tôi đã bị xấu hổ và nhục nhã.
vi.R: Suốt ngày tôi sẽ nói về việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm điều đúng. \q Những kẻ muốn hại tôi đã bị xấu hổ và nhục nhã.

ko.L: 제 혀도 온종일 주님의 의를 말할 것입니다. \q 제가 해를 입기를 바라던 자들이 부끄러움을 당하고 낭패를 당하였기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 제 혀는 온종일 주님의 의를 이야기할 것입니다. \q 저를 해치려던 사람들이 수치를 당하고 고개를 떨구었기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 얼마나 옳은 일을 하시는지 저는 온종일 이야기하겠습니다. \q 저를 해치려던 사람들이 부끄러움과 창피를 당했습니다.

pt.L: Também a minha língua falará o dia todo [da] {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} justiça, \q pois estão envergonhados, pois estão confundidos os que buscam o meu mal.
pt.B: O dia inteiro a minha língua falará da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} justiça, \q pois os que buscavam o meu mal estão envergonhados e humilhados.
pt.R: O dia inteiro vou falar de como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fazes o que é certo. \q As pessoas que queriam me fazer mal estão envergonhadas e desonradas.

am.L: አንደበቴም ደግሞ ቀኑን ሁሉ ጽድቅህን ያወራል፤ \q ጉዳቴን የሚሹ አፍረዋልና፤ ተዋርደዋልምና።
am.B: አንደበቴ ቀኑን ሙሉ ስለ ጽድቅህ ይናገራል፤ \q ጉዳቴን የፈለጉ ሰዎች አፍረዋልና፤ ተዋርደዋልምና።
am.R: ትክክል የሆነውን እንዴት እንደምታደርግ ቀኑን ሙሉ አወራለሁ። \q ሊጎዱኝ የፈለጉ ሰዎች አፍረዋል፤ ተዋርደዋልም።

hi.L: मेरी जीभ भी दिन भर तेरी धार्मिकता की चर्चा करती रहेगी, \q क्योंकि वे लज्जित हुए हैं, क्योंकि वे व्याकुल हुए हैं, जो मेरी हानि चाहते थे।
hi.B: दिन भर मेरी जीभ तेरी धार्मिकता का बखान करेगी, \q क्योंकि जो मेरा बुरा चाहते थे, वे लज्जित और नीचे किए गए हैं।
hi.R: दिन भर मैं बताता रहूँगा कि तू कैसे सही काम करता है। \q जो लोग मुझे हानि पहुँचाना चाहते थे, वे लज्जित और अपमानित हो गए हैं।

ru.L: И язык мой весь день будет говорить [о] праведности {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}}, \q потому что постыжены, потому что посрамлены ищущие мне зла.
ru.B: Весь день мой язык будет говорить о {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} праведности, \q потому что те, кто искал мне вреда, постыжены и унижены.
ru.R: Весь день я буду рассказывать, как {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} поступаешь правильно. \q Люди, которые хотели причинить мне зло, опозорены и посрамлены.

ja.L: わたしの舌もまた、一日中、あなたの義を口ずさむ。 \q まことに、恥を見、まことに、うろたえたのだ、わたしの災いを求める者たちは。
ja.B: わたしの舌は一日中、あなたの義を語り続ける。 \q わたしを傷つけようとした者たちは、恥を受け、うろたえたからだ。
ja.R: 一日中、わたしは、あなたが正しいことをなさることを話そう。 \q わたしを傷つけたいと思っていた人たちは、恥をかき、面目を失ったのだから。

decisions.choice: they are ashamed: as good as done
decisions.reason: The verbs are in the past tense. He speaks of the enemies' defeat as already certain, the answer to his prayer in verse 13.

decisions.choice: murmur: speak over and over
decisions.reason: The verb (hagah) is used of quiet, repeated speaking or musing (1:2; 35:28).

decisions.choice: boshu / chaferu as done: past "恥を見…うろたえた" (L, B), "恥をかき、面目を失った" (R); tehgeh "口ずさむ" (L), "語り続ける" (B), "話そう" (R)
decisions.reason: The enemies' shame is spoken of as already done (m1, uncertain); hagah is speaking over and over (m2), 口ずさむ at L as 1:2.
